versions.changelog:
effector-ecosystem 0.6.0

- Added full audit mode: skill now supports deep, cross-cutting project audits with specific guidance for startup flow, auth lifecycle, remote operations, scope/external handles, reactive purity, and React async boundaries.
- SKILL.md extended with precise static audit graphs and acceptance criteria for systematic code review.
- Added new reference: production audit playbook.
- Improved documentation and clarified skill activation/use-cases.
- Updated multiple example, template, and reference files for consistency and expanded best practice coverage.

effector-ecosystem 0.5.0

- Separated Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) structure questions into a new effector-fsd skill; this skill no longer covers FSD placement or boundaries.
- Updated SKILL.md to clarify project-structure agnosticism and refocus on Effector, Farfetched, Atomic Router, and ecosystem model/code design.
- Adjusted activation triggers and first-response logic to avoid FSD decisions unless effector-fsd is in use.
- Removed or reorganized FSD-specific reference and template files.
- Clarified architectural principles and examples for "dumb UI," model shape, and Farfetched usage.

effector-ecosystem v0.4.1

- Documentation and reference sections updated for clarity and accuracy.
- Refined guidance on Farfetched usage, including concurrency and error mapping.
- Expanded anti-patterns section with more detailed explanations.
- Improved and reorganized project templates and code examples.
- Next.js, testing, routing, and forms integration notes revised and clarified.

**Next.js and advanced Farfetched/effector integrations, new templates, and expanded best practices.**

- Added examples and templates for Next.js App Router, protected routes with Farfetched, and SSR/hydration setup.
- Expanded documentation and references: new guide files for Next.js, auth flows, and ecosystem integration.
- Updated recommendations for query/mutation handling, route-driven data loading, and concurrency in Farfetched.
- Clarified best practices for app startup, scope management, and complex project structure.
- Improved anti-patterns and review checklists for modern effector/FSD+Next.js scenarios.

**Summary:** This release introduces stricter guidance for model decomposition, refactoring, and data transformation location within Effector/FSD projects.

- Emphasize splitting large models into concern-based submodels (e.g., `$$form`, `$$list`, `$$filters`, `$$dialog`).
- Recommend extracting all non-trivial data transformation (mapping, sorting, formatting) into named pure functions or helpers outside models.
- Add rules discouraging oversized models and long inline mapping/grouping in reactive operators.
- Update anti-patterns, modeling, contracts, and checklist documentation to reflect these best practices.
- Clarify model boundary responsibilities and recommended file placements.

- Expanded Effector model guidelines with explicit support for factories, recommending their use for repeated, independent logic and clarifying usage with SSR/Scope.
- Updated principle 3 to mention [`@withease/factories`](https://withease.effector.dev/factories/) and Effector Babel/SWC plugin configuration.
- Small edits and clarifications to project structure and non-negotiable principles.
- Reference files updated for more complete package guidance and ecosystem notes.

- Added and clarified React-style `on*` handler aliasing in `useUnit` bindings for connected components; Effector event names remain as facts in models.
- Improved guidance on naming conventions and best practices for React/Effector integration.
- Updated references, templates, and examples across documentation and sample code for clarity and current recommendations.
- Removed deprecated skill-card documentation file.
- General editorial improvements for readability and structure throughout the documentation.

**Expanded best practices, added new templates, and updated references for broader Effector ecosystem and React integration.**

- Expanded guidance for React/Effector integration: added detailed binding rules, `useUnit` recommendations, and new constraints for SSR/scope-safe callbacks.
- Broadened package support and references, including Farfetched, contracts, effector-forms, atomic-router, effector-storage, @effector/next, @effector/reflect, and more.
- Added references/10-ecosystem-library-notes.md for detailed ecosystem library usage notes.
- Introduced new templates: persistent store, react-connected component.
- Updated and extended anti-patterns, review checklist, and best practices files.
- Removed deprecated or outdated documentation.
Initial release with Effector, FSD, Farfetched, contracts, routing, forms, persistence, i18n, testing references, and reusable templates.
